rationale: The actual implementation fixes stage gesture leakage in the existing wall-thickness dialog and LED picker, both present in stable v1.80.1. Native text selection, dialog wheel ownership and fixed screen position restore those workflows; bounded session-only dialog dragging is the small accompanying polish requested in the original report. There are no persisted fields or migration. This replaces the earlier documentation-only accounting now that the product fix is delivered.

summary.ru: Поле толщины стены и окно выбора LED-устройства больше не двигают план при работе внутри них. Диалог толщины можно перетащить по экрану, сохраняя доступ к полю и кнопкам.
summary.en: Using the wall-thickness field or LED device picker no longer moves the plan underneath. Drag the thickness dialog on screen while keeping its field and buttons accessible.
